name: experience-signature-capture
title: Experience Layer 3.2: signatureTag auto-candidate + reviewer override at finding_add
description: Make finding_add populate a signatureTag even when the reviewer does not supply one, by deriving a canonical candidate from the finding's category/files/desc through the existing signature-registry, and record whether the tag is auto-derived or reviewer-confirmed. This fixes the Baseline-A signature-degradation bottleneck for forward findings: the real-quality signal comes from confirmed tags (LLM reviewers set good ones; the later 3.5 backfill upgrades historical ones), while the auto-candidate is a non-empty fallback. signatureTag and the new source flag are audit-only: excluded from the finding _hash, every gate, and the finding signature.
